owner_approval.decision_note: Owner reaffirmed OPTION_A in Task 2B-R. Approval is limited to comparator selection; held-out execution remains unauthorized. Original selection timestamp was not available; this timestamp records the explicit reaffirmation.

benchmark.split_hash_note: SHA-256 over canonical sorted partition membership only; no outcome values.

evaluation.execution_policy: LOCKED; comparator approval only. Do not execute this potentially exposed evaluation set as pristine confirmatory validation.
evaluation.post_evaluation_policy: No score, split, comparator, threshold, or endpoint changes may be presented as a fresh held-out test. Any changed method requires a new prospective dataset/split.
permitted_reporting: predeclared paired uncertainty interval if implemented without tuning

ranking.tie_break: ascending string case identifier, matching current ranking implementation
ranking.zero_score: valid numeric score; retain in ranking, apply deterministic tie rule
ranking.missing_or_nonfinite: unassessable; exclude from score ordering and report coverage; never convert to negative

evaluation.uncertainty: Use the frozen score-lock published MN9 SD at 50 Hz and its 1e-12 floor; no held-out-derived uncertainty or calibration.
evaluation.thresholds: No classification threshold is a primary held-out endpoint. Any descriptive threshold must be fitted on development only and frozen before authorization.
evaluation.common_denominator: Report each system's coverage and the predeclared common-assessable subset; do not turn absent predictions into negative labels.
evaluation.numerical_tolerance: 1e-9 for deterministic reproduction comparisons where the same computational outputs are compared; not a ranking-performance margin.

approved_primary_set.definition: Frozen per-case degree_preserving_rewire score_hz; no uncertainty normalization or evidence/capability multipliers.
The same frozen rewire score divided by the frozen mean published MN9 SD at 50 Hz; gates omitted.
Exact score-lock v1 construction: rewire score / frozen uncertainty times evidence and capability gates.
Deterministic seeded random score over the declared benchmark case identifiers using the frozen runner implementation; seed 17092026. This is a negative reference, not a tuned scientific baseline.

excluded_legacy_comparators.definition_in_existing_evaluator: 1/(1 + shortest_path); forbidden as a Workbench score input. Inclusion requires owner approval and an explicit rationale for this retrospective comparator.
Mean published left/right MN9 model rate at 50 Hz; currently duplicates effect_only in that evaluator.
